identity_profiles.signed_viewer_session: short-lived server-signed viewer session with no write capability
identity_profiles.signed_viewer_refresh: single-use server-bound refresh identity for the same viewer subject
identity_profiles.exact_public_viewer_fixed_bearer: literal public viewer bearer; forbidden in final design
identity_profiles.revoked_viewer_session: viewer access session revoked by exact logout
identity_profiles.revoked_viewer_refresh: refresh identity consumed, replayed, or revoked with its refresh family
identity_profiles.near_match_public_viewer_bearer: subject differs from the exact public viewer by a near-match mutation
identity_profiles.viewer_refresh_role_upgrade_attempt: same viewer refresh with a requested or forged role upgrade
identity_profiles.viewer_refresh_capability_upgrade_attemp: same viewer refresh with a requested or forged capability upgrade

transport_profiles.secure_http_only_cookie: __Host- Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/ access-session cookie with no Domain
transport_profiles.secure_http_only_refresh_cookie: separate __Host- Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/ refresh-family cookie with no Domain
transport_profiles.secure_http_only_cookie_pair: access-session and refresh-family cookies, each __Host- Secure HttpOnly SameSite=Lax Path=/ with no Domain
transport_profiles.mixed_bearer_and_cookie: simultaneous bearer and cookie; ambiguous and forbidden
transport_profiles.raw_literal_cookie: literal public viewer value placed in Cookie transport; forbidden
transport_profiles.credential_shaped_json_body: literal public viewer value placed in a JSON credential body; forbidden

exact_configured_frontend_origin.match: byte-exact configured Pantheon frontend origin including scheme, host, and port

unconfigured_cross_origin.match: any origin not byte-equal to the configured Pantheon frontend origin

viewer_session_and_refresh.refresh_family_cookie: valid member of the same viewer refresh family

cleared_session_family.refresh_family_cookie: expired with Max-Age=0 and server family revoked

raw_literal_viewer_cookie.access_session_cookie: literal public viewer credential rather than a signed session

evidence_contract.reference_format: relative JSON pointer into secret-free qualification output

rows.frontend_callsite: TopBar startup badge and transport summary
method override header and body qualification
